snippet.title: Austerity X – Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4397240/Austerity_X/
Follow for updates : https://x.com/AlexOD_FG
Official website : https://www.alexodonnell.co.uk/

It's election season in the UK. Justine visits Barmford to ask the cross-obsessed locals who they're voting for in this classic survival horror. Find rabbit holes and uncover scandals as you unveil the gruesome reality behind Michael Hallow's 30 year reign as mayor, before the calendar runs out.

Explore Barmford at Day and Night: Choose how you spend each day in Barmford, whether its uncovering the next rabbit hole, spending time with the locals or gathering scarce resources to prepare for what's next.

Make it to the deadline: Every day the town, your surroundings and your sanity become increasingly depleted. You also need to make sure you have some form of report for your paper before the end of the month.

#indiehorror #pixelart #survivalhorror #gamedev
